item.title: Aishwarya Sakhuja opens up on healing and embracing her true self
item.description: Taking to Instagram, the actress penned an introspective note about becoming more patient with her healing journey and allowing herself to grow without shrinking her thoughts. She emphasised that strength does not always manifest as intensity, but sometimes as quiet restraint.

item.title: With advent of spring, Kolkata, south Bengal record this year's first rain
item.description: Kolkata: With the advent of spring, Kolkata and south Bengal districts on Tuesday received this year's first rain, Regional Meteorological Centre (RMC) said.Kolkata and its surrounding areas recorded light to moderate rain which started from 4 a.m. Along with this, scattered rain occurred in various districts. item.title: Engine Glitch Prompts Full Emergency On SpiceJet Delhi–Leh Flight; Aircraft Returns Safely
item.description: A SpiceJet Boeing 737 operating flight SG121 from Delhi to Leh declared a full emergency after an engine malfunction and returned safely to the capital with around 150 passengers onboard.

item.title: Family of Three Commits Suicide in Amberpet
item.description: Amberpet, Hyderabad — A tragic incident has occurred in Amberpet, where three members of the same family took their own lives. The deceased have been identified as Rama Raju (55), Madhavi (50), and their son Shashank (24).Police arrived at the scene to examine the bodies and conduct investigations. It is believed that the family may have been driven to despair due to financial difficulties. item.description: Internal documents reveal Meta advanced Messenger encryption plans despite warnings it could significantly reduce child exploitation reporting capabilities.

item.title: PM Modi Congratulates Manipuri Film Boong on BAFTA Awards 2026 Win
